results.title: Global AND view filters

results.title: Comparison operators

results.title: Symbolic boolean operators and truthiness
results.notes: Symbolic logic and numeric truthiness are compiled to boolean predicates before evaluation.

results.title: Bare, note-dot and bracket properties
results.notes: Bracketed note keys use typed literal-key lookups, preserving whitespace, dots and reserved names.

results.title: Arithmetic and precedence
results.notes: Arithmetic precedence, grouping, unary minus, division and modulo.

results.title: Formula references in filters
results.notes: Dotted and bracketed formula references resolve through the same execution compiler without rewriting string literals.

results.title: Formula chains and formula sorting
results.notes: Formula chains preserve arithmetic precedence and both formula-ID spellings sort by evaluated values.

results.title: this binding
results.notes: A query has no owning-note binding in BasesTable or QueryController; real embed ownership needs a host fixture.

difference.reason: Host-specific this binding needs an explicit owning-file context contract; do not infer it from a global App.

results.title: File fields

results.title: Frontmatter links resolve as typed links

difference.reason: Typed link/file resolution requires the complete host-owned value-wrapper contract, not a string approximation.
